lines.1: 「Track practice is getting busier for me too, and I want to train later. I won't be coming by to cook nearly as often.」
lines.2: He had never said anything like that before.
lines.3: 「So why don't you learn to cook too? It'll come in handy.」
lines.4: 「I guess if Subaru stops making dinner, I'll have no choice but to cook for myself.」
lines.8: 「Has this house maintained even its present standard of cleanliness because Date has been cleaning it?」
lines.9: 「I may not look it, but I like things clean. I took care of it whenever I had time.」
lines.10: 「So cooking was not the only way you looked after him.」
lines.11: 「...What exactly is the relationship between you and Date?」
lines.16: 「I understand that love takes many forms and that interfering would be tactless. But even so--though the Princess might be delighted--」
lines.23: 「I know how to beat a rotten nature back into shape, but I know nothing whatsoever about that particular subject.」
lines.25: 「Why so formal all of a sudden?」
lines.26: 「It seems my blood relative Leo has been in your care. Allow me to thank you properly.」
lines.29: Even Subaru had gotten swept up in Otome's pace.
lines.30: 「Anyway, now there are two of you. From here on out, you can manage things yourselves.」
lines.31: 「Of course, you're welcome to call me if you run into trouble.」
